changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: A test uses a fraction of a reagent unit (0.5 mL per test is configured on the Test Catalog), but consumption required at least 1, so recording the use of a test's reagent failed. A use only has to be more than nothing.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.inventory_usage DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_usage_quantity; ALTER TABLE clinlims.inventory_usage ADD CONSTRAINT chk_usage_quantity CHECK (quantity_used > 0);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.inventory_usage DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_usage_quantity; ALTER TABLE clinlims.inventory_usage ADD CONSTRAINT chk_usage_quantity CHECK (quantity_used >= 1);
